name: CHIP-8
author: NucleoOS; games by the CHIP-8 Community Archive authors
description: A CHIP-8, SUPER-CHIP and XO-CHIP console with 83 homebrew games from the CHIP-8 Community Archive built in. Tap a game to play: hex keypad on screen (the keys each game uses light up), gamepads and USB keyboards work too, XO-CHIP colours and sound.

descriptions.en: A CHIP-8, SUPER-CHIP and XO-CHIP console with 83 homebrew games from the CHIP-8 Community Archive built in. Tap a game to play: hex keypad on screen (the keys each game uses light up), gamepads and USB keyboards work too, XO-CHIP colours and sound.
descriptions.it: Una console CHIP-8, SUPER-CHIP e XO-CHIP con 83 giochi homebrew del CHIP-8 Community Archive gia' inclusi. Tocca un gioco per giocare: tastierino esadecimale sullo schermo (si accendono i tasti che usa ogni gioco), funzionano anche gamepad e tastiere USB, colori e suono XO-CHIP.
